note: Single declarative source of truth for what components the brain has and how each is measured. Read by BOTH the nightly contribution writer (Python) and the frontend (TS). It declares EXISTENCE and HOW-IT-WOULD-BE-MEASURED only; it carries NO measured numbers (those live in the contribution ledger, built in BV-03, joined on the stable `id`). Adding/removing/renaming/re-parenting a component is a data edit here, never a code change. Source inventory: DESIGN_DOSSIER.md §1 (20260623_trader-bot-brain-visualizer-committee).
id_rules: `id` is the stable join key: never display text, never reused, never an index. `label` is the only display string. Status is honest and number-free: `expected_status` is what the component is FOR (live/comparison/retired/planned); `instrumentation_status` is orthogonal (can the surface measure it yet). `live-but-dark` (runs, moves nothing live) is recorded as a pathway note, not a number — the measured zero joins from the ledger.
